cases.label: Weapon Swings, Hits, Blocks, Explosions, Ability Sound Set
required_tools_ordered: parallax sfx find (Creator Store / CC0 / Sonniss GDC, --describe via CLAP)
parallax sfx listen (Owner picks <=3 refs/class -> references.json)
parallax sfx new sound / sets/<set>.json (real recordings layered with synth, roles transient/body/sub/mechanical/tail/sweetener/air, seeded noise, round-robin, +/-2 LU class loudness)

forbidden_tools.why: Synth-only sword/weapon sets are graveyard (4-5/10); real layered recordings are required for the material and impact to read.
Unseeded short noise bursts produce identical variance on every hit, which the ear recognises as robotic.
Judging sound alone without the hit video misses AV sync drift and impact frame alignment.
Masking layers in the same frequency band cancel each other out and thin the impact.

cases.capability_policy: Full-capability, case-matched execution (NEVER artificially minimal): use the ENTIRE pipeline whenever the piece benefits from it; `required_tools_ordered` is the quality floor, extra non-forbidden pipeline tools are ALWAYS allowed, `forbidden_tools` blocks ONLY tools that degrade this case, and edge-case skips require `--skip-tool <tool> --why "<reason>"` logged to `.verify/parallax_session.json`.
examples: build a sword hit sound set with real layered recordings and AV sync check
create a combat impact sfx set with round-robin hits and owner booth approval
make an explosion ability sound with transient/body/tail layers and CLAP find

cases.label: World Ambience, Room Reverb, Wind, Echoes
required_tools_ordered: parallax sfx sketch (beds + events + vetted OpenAIR CC-BY IRs)
runtime Audio API (SoundService.AcousticSimulationEnabled=true, AngleAttenuation, pooled AudioReverb, WindVoice, GustEvents, EchoZones on unified clock)

forbidden_tools.why: Legacy Sound/SoundGroup bypasses the spatial Audio API graph and loses AngleAttenuation and AudioReverb.
Mixing os.clock() in EchoZones/Ambience causes drift from the unified simulation clock and desynchronises audio events.
